[[Company Brain]] › Reference › awdiscord configuration

A selection of the environment variables [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]] reads. <code>awdiscord setup</code> writes them to <code>~/.awdiscord/awdiscord.env</code> (mode 600).

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Variable
! Meaning
! Concept
|-
| <code>DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN</code> / <code>AWDISCORD_TOKEN</code>
| The bot token
| [[Company Brain/Guide: setting up your company brain in Discord#Step 3 — Install and run the bot|Guide step 3]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_AGENT_URL</code>, <code>_MODEL</code>, <code>_KEY</code>
| The agent behind <code>/ask</code>
| [[Company Brain/Bring your own model|Bring your own model]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_PERSONAS_DIR</code>
| <code>&lt;name&gt;.md</code> or <code>&lt;name&gt;/SOUL.md</code> files become <code>/ask persona:</code> choices
| [[Company Brain/Plugins and packs|Plugins and packs]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_OPERATORS</code>
| User ids who may press approval buttons
| [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_APPROVAL_SECRET</code>
| HMAC secret for buttons and callbacks
| [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_APPROVAL_CHANNEL</code>
| Post cards here instead of DMing operators
| [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_INBOX_PORT</code>, <code>_TOKEN</code>, <code>_HOST</code>
| Local inbox for approvals and notifications
| [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_SERVED_GUILDS</code>
| Server ids allowed to use the owner’s model
| [[Company Brain/Safety rails|Safety rails]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_STANDALONE=1</code>
| Self-hosted: the env agent answers every server the bot is in
| [[Company Brain/Bring your own model|Bring your own model]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_STATE_DIR</code>
| Where approvals and keys are stored (default <code>~/.awdiscord</code>)
| [[Company Brain/Safety rails|Safety rails]]
|-
| <code>AWDISCORD_DEV_GUILD</code>
| Also register commands on one server (instant, for testing)
| [[Company Brain/Guide: setting up your company brain in Discord|Guide]]
|}
